title: [BUG] JSON schema is invalid. It must match JSON Schema draft 2020-12
author: sir4ur0n

top_comments.author: jeffrey-l-turner
top_comments.body: I see the same thing b/c of a bad mcp server -- specifically I tried using https://github.com/sylphxltd/pdf-reader-mcp. You may want to check your `~/.claude.json` or `.mcp.json` configurations

top_comments.author: sir4ur0n
top_comments.body:
See the "Steps to Reproduce" section of my original message: the MCP server originally works fine.
It only breaks after changing the Zod schema.
So I don't see how it can be related to a bad MCP server configuration in the Claude settings.

top_comments.author: Lucheti
top_comments.body: Thank god i found this, i was getting mad crazy with it. That's 100% the cause of that error. @sir4ur0n mvp!
